t: What Protein Structure and Function Database Is All About
title: What Protein Structure and Function Database Is All About
description: Protein structure is function made physical: hemoglobin's four subunits cooperatively grab oxygen (sigmoidal binding curve), lysozyme's cleft precisely fits bacterial cell walls, and antibodies' Y-shape presents variable tips for antigens. Anfinsen showed sequence determines structure (Nobel 1972); AlphaFold (2020) now predicts structures from sequence alone. Four levels: primary sequence, secondary helices/sheets, tertiary fold, quaternary assembly. This database is the complete protein: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Protein Structure and Function Database: a complete reference database of full protein records.
